_comment: Quarter of a 2x2 one-way mini roundabout, state 0 (frame of T 39: arms x-, z-, z+; +x closed; the block centre is the corner (x 0, z 255)). ENGLISH (right-hand traffic) runs the ring counter-clockwise seen from above: ring = x- (0,80) -> z+ (175,255), the outer lane of a curve round the block centre, radius 175 (same circle in every quarter). Entry from the arm: z- (175,0) -> z+ (175,255), straight, tangent to the ring where it joins it. Exit to the arm: x- (0,80) -> z- (80,0), a right turn of radius 80. No lane comes closer than 175 to the block centre; the art's island (netpaint paint.json) has radius 130 including its edge line. English-UK: lanekit mirror_uk reverses every lane (clockwise ring, left-hand traffic). Pinwheel (agreed with artkit and multitile): (x,z) state 3, (x+1,z) state 0, (x,z+1) state 2, (x+1,z+1) state 1; exits W, N, E, S. Pedestrian graph: the T's.
